rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIfigu
Exhibition name: Lady X
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1965).
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1969 as 'Lady X'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. Mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Few or no prickles/thorns, upright. Leathery foliage.

Height: 5' to 7' (150 to 215cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 2,691 on 13 Dec 1966 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: Different parentages are listed in the references
